evidence.reason: The finding described a real pre-fix TOCTOU/provenance race: the probe could reread its host source from __file__ after a working-tree change and record/pin bytes B while the interpreter had loaded A. History commit c49d8a49e329b9cdb6905be6e580c60430e96365 (“launch run from the verified host byte buffer”) directly fixes this by launching from the verified host byte buffer rather than rereading the mutable working-tree source later.
